sources.topic: NODE_SIZE includes node data and excludes header; native random-file layout is outside this implementation
INTSCT_VL_PL and V_FIND_VLINE record schemas, application frame, focal point, direction/polarity, IDs and appended results

implementation.node_size: Packed concrete schema widths independent of values, node count and header; sum records, multiply each array dimension once
implementation.intersection: Structural view-line and point PATH fields; complete supplied Cartesian plane; signed infinite-line intersections and normalized oblique-projected polarity; explicit group/frame metadata and model IDs
implementation.atomicity: Stage all nodes before append/header mutation; retain existing nodes, check same-frame output and node capacity, charge each input to step budget; disjoint status/output checks

portable_choices.sizes: BYTE/BOOLEAN 1, SHORT 2, INTEGER/REAL 4, STRING capacity, JOINTPOS 4 per axis; records sum fields, no padding/prefix/native descriptors
portable_choices.tolerance: Parallel when absolute plane-normal dot unit-direction <= 1e-12
portable_choices.status: 0 success, 1 parallel, 2 degenerate vector or zero focal-plane distance, 3 output frame/group mismatch, 4 capacity; invalid/uninitialized data/matrix/budget errors raise
portable_choices.geometry: Infinite lines allow negative distances, which reverse normalized projected polarity; plane already expressed in same application frame; empty source copies valid header

unresolved: Native PATH binary file layout, serializer and exact byte sizes
Vision acquisition, camera calibration, asynchronous processing and V_FIND_VLINE execution
Native numerical/status equivalence and strict mode
QUEUE_ATTACH belongs to native message attachments and remains unimplemented
